snippets.text:
1403| def classify_failure(subtask: dict[str, Any], outcome: Any) -> str:
1404|     """Map a rejected subtask to a control-loop failure branch.
1405| 
1406|     * ``transient`` — timeout / model-network error / crash / lock conflict and
1407|       attempts remain: retry the SAME subtask (attempt+1), plan unchanged.
1408|     * ``structural`` — forced: the executor was blocked (no tools at all), the
1409|       workspace was rejected, or the attempt budget is exhausted.
1410|     * ``rewrite_remaining`` — otherwise (wrong approach). The rewrite proposal
1411|       is still diffed: if it changes steps/deps/criteria it is escalated to
1412|       ``structural`` by the control loop.
1413|     """
1414|     stop = getattr(outcome, "stop_reason", None) or ""
1415|     error = getattr(outcome, "error", None) or ""

1498| def reset_subtask_for_retry(subtask: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1499|     """Transient failure: same node, bump attempt, clear running fields."""
1500|     s = dict(subtask)
1501|     s["status"] = SUBTASK_PENDING
1502|     s["attempt_number"] = int(s.get("attempt_number") or 0)  # bumped when leased
1503|     s["error"] = None
1504|     s["stop_reason"] = ""
1505|     s["result_summary"] = ""
1506|     s["result_full"] = ""
1507|     s["finished_at"] = None
1508|     s["finished_seq"] = None
1509|     # Keep acceptance_evidence from the failed attempt for diagnostics.
1510|     return s

issues: 子任务1为 analyze 却包含 targets 且 status=to-verify 的 app/engine/workflow.py::verify_subtask_node，规则要求 analysis 目标禁止 modify；此处虽 kind=analyze 但 targets 指向待修改候选，且 to-verify 符号不应作为分析确认依据，应移除或明确只读。
子任务2的修复方案自相矛盾：描述中同时给出“若租约处未 bump 则在此 +1；若租约已 bump 则修正被覆盖的写法”，未在分析结论前确定唯一修复点，导致 modify 目标不确定，可能误改 classify_failure 与 reset_subtask_for_retry 两处。
子任务2的验收标准声称“经 reset_subtask_for_retry 后 attempt_number 递增为 1”，但 E1 证据显示该函数注释为 bumped when leased，且函数体只读取不递增；在未确认租约逻辑前，该期望行为缺乏证据支撑，属于编造预期。
子任务3的 write_scope 为 tests/test_task_graph.py，但描述称“新增/扩展测试（新建测试函数，文件已存在）”，未明确是修改既有文件还是新建文件；规则要求新建文件须在描述中标明，此处表述含糊。
子任务3的 targets 指向 test_classify_failure_branches，但描述要新增独立用例，targets 与实际修改符号不一致，应指向新增测试函数或明确修改既有函数。
子任务4 verify 的边界提到 pytest tests/test_residual_033.py，该文件未在探索证据中出现，属于编造未验证的测试目标。
整体缺少对“超时”具体 stop_reason 取值的证据：E3 仅显示 classify_failure 文档字符串，未展示 timeout 分支实际代码，子任务2直接断言超时归 transient 缺乏 confirmed 证据。
步骤数4在 bugfix 上限5内，但子任务1与2可合并为一次定位+修复，当前拆分导致分析结论未落地即进入修改，规划冗余。
